The Glasshouse dashboard for LG webOS TVs, on the phone.
This app connects to the Glasshouse server, which runs on rooted LG webOS TVs. The server has to be installed on the TV first: the app does not install it or root the TV.
With Glasshouse running, scan any QR code on the TV\'s dashboard, or enter the TV\'s address.
The phone and the TV need to be on the same network.
A phone app for the Glasshouse dashboard, which runs on rooted LG webOS TVs. It keeps a list of TVs and opens each one\'s dashboard.
